title: Failure Inventory
description: ANALYZE-stage artifact. Output of failure-case-miner. A typed inventory of individual failure cases from results, each tagged with a failure type and supporting evidence. Requires at least one typed failure entry.

condition_id.description: The condition or run this failure inventory covers

type.description: Failure type label, e.g. false_positive, false_negative, boundary_error, connectivity_failure, shape_mismatch, outlier, oom, other

description.description: Human-readable description of the failure case

case_ref.description: Reference to the specific sample/case/image_id if known

hypothesized_cause.description: Speculated root cause of this failure (advisory, not verified)

failures.description: List of individual failure cases. minItems 1 ensures non-empty inventory.

summary.description: Optional overall summary of failure patterns

sources_read.description: R3 C4 (2026-08-07). OPTIONAL. Run-relative paths the failure-case-miner actually read while mining this inventory. Preserves grounding the worker prompt already asks for but the producer previously dropped before this field existed.
